name: Marcilla de Campos (Spain)
description: Square flag horizontally divided red over green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Marcilla de Campos (a figure on red and a sheaf on green).
history: Municipal flag of Marcilla de Campos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Marcilla de Campos arms — figure on red and sheaf on green
